## About this page

*Only in Android and the desktop app.*

How the widgets look, which buttons the quick bar has, what its lock button does, and which codes the Codes widget shows.

#### How it works

Which widget shows what is under [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget). Whether any widget may show codes or favorites is decided under Security, by [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access).

#### On Android

Which widget shows what is under [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget). Whether any widget may show codes or favorites is [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access), on this page and under Security.

See also [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget), [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access).

<a id="setting-widget-colours"></a>

## Colors

*Only in Android.*

The colours the widgets draw in.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| App theme | The theme, accent and dark mode you chose for WM Pass. |
| Wallpaper colors | The colours Android takes from your wallpaper, as other apps' widgets use. Before Android 12 this is the app theme. |
| Dark | Dark at all times, in the dark side of the app theme. |

See also [Background](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-background).

<a id="setting-widget-background"></a>

## Background

*Only in Android.*

What is behind a widget's buttons and text.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Solid | A solid card. |
| See-through | A card the wallpaper shows through a little. |
| None | No card: the buttons sit on the wallpaper. Text on a busy wallpaper can be hard to read. |

See also [Colors](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-colours).

<a id="setting-widget-buttons"></a>

## Quick bar

*Only in Android and the desktop app.*

The buttons on the quick bar widget, in order.

#### How it works

Drag a row by its handle to move it. The bin removes it, and its own row below, such as **Add Health**, brings it back.

A quick bar too narrow for all of them shows the first ones that fit.

See also [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget), [Lock button](/guide/settings/widgets/#setting-widget-lock).

<a id="setting-widget-lock"></a>

## Lock button

*Only in Android and the desktop app.*

What the lock button on the quick bar and a tap on the Lock status widget do while the vault is open.

#### When to use it

Panic lock suits a phone or computer that may be taken from you while the vault is open. Nothing is erased, and after the hour your password works again.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Lock | Locks the vault. |
| Panic lock | Locks the vault and refuses every password for an hour, even the right one. |

See also [Lock and refuse passwords now](/guide/settings/security/#action-panic-now), [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget).

<a id="setting-widget-codes"></a>

## Codes on widgets

*Only in Android and the desktop app.*

Which items' codes the Codes widget shows, up to eight, in the order of your list. With none chosen, it shows your favorites that have a code.

#### How it works

Counter-based codes are never shown there, since showing one uses it up.

#### Limits

Only while [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access) is on and the vault is open.

See also [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access).

<a id="setting-widget-codes-mode"></a>

## Codes ahead

*Only in the desktop app.*

How far ahead the Mac's Codes widget is given its codes.

#### Why it is there

macOS lets a widget redraw only a few dozen times a day while its app is behind other windows, too few for a code that changes every 30 seconds.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| The next few minutes | The widget is given the codes up to the time the vault would lock by itself, at most 10 minutes ahead, so it keeps counting while WM Pass is behind other windows. |
| Only the current code | When a code runs out, the widget asks you to open WM Pass until it is redrawn. That is quick while WM Pass is in front, and rare while it is behind other windows. |

See also [Show on widgets](/guide/settings/security/#setting-widget-access).

<a id="setting-desktop-widgets"></a>

## Offer widgets

*Only in the desktop app.*

Whether the Mac's widget gallery offers WM Pass's widgets. Off takes them away and empties the file they read.

#### Limits

Widgets need macOS 14 or later.

See also [Widgets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-home-widget).
